> [!CAUTION]
> If you have found a critical exploitable vulnerability, please DO NOT post sensitive exploit details in a public issue.
> Refer to [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) to report via GitHub Security Advisories or by emailing `2539027131@stu.xjtu.edu.cn`.

**Vulnerability Summary**
Brief overview of the security issue.

**Affected Component**
Module / CLI command / Analyzer / Sandbox.

**Potential Impact**
Severity, CWE classification, and consequences if unpatched.

**Proposed Mitigation**
Suggested patch or architectural adjustment.
